carrier.internalCountsScope: Actual top-level kernel API attempts/returns/throws. Internal calls between exports are not intercepted.

readout.scope: Fixed complete readout mathematics only, not audio/Chart/human music qualification.
readout.internalCountsScope: Returned readout work, not independently intercepted nested calls.

resources.observationScope: Sampled process memory, not continuous/RSS hard cap or phone measurement; full readouts released by runCase scope, normal GC timing uncontrolled.

patch.format: ordinary git diff a/src b/src; git apply on accepted baseline, no QA path resolver or source regeneration

compatibilityAliases.purpose: TC1 applyTactusAnalysis bridge; historical filename retained only for the frozen Chart integration
TC1 selectTactusOnsets finite selector; historical filename retained only for integration

analysisMetadata.purpose: Actual TC1 metadata property; not a compatibility alias or an RME1 readout

manifest.scope: Source-only passive archive. No source imports, candidate/helper/optimizer/Chart/analyzer/FFT calls, audio/PCM reads, metrics, tracked writes, commits or publication.

expectedIndependentVerification.command: ordinary git apply --check then git apply in a separate QA baseline tree
expectedIndependentVerification.compare: all31 applied files vs actual frozen C source bytes

limitations: Only the fixed original41 observed development cache; no fresh/sealed music.
Five observed clips are five genre proxies, not a ten-genre population.
Inherited B rejection is not an actual C analyzer rejection or end-to-end status parity.
Clock metric uses Analysis.rhythm.beats; B low-support chartBeats can differ from that sequence. Head metric uses uniqueHeads of the one-finger chart.
Ordered source observations, conservative readout, physical onset pool, count retention and identity are separate.
A single bounded Node run does not establish phone performance, perceived musical quality or a full pipeline test.
